premise: I get hit by a truck and wake up in a fantasy world as a hero with an overpowered cheat skill.

bible.title: Reborn with a Cheat Skill
bible.era: Medieval fantasy with a magical System governing reality

extraordinary.reach: Casters can summon storms, conjure fire, and heal deep wounds.
Gives status screens, tracks levels, and bestows specialized skills to all living creatures.

peoples.name: Humans
peoples.culture: A medieval society focused on rank, leveling, and dungeon exploration.

creatures.name: Goblin
creatures.description: Green-skinned, vicious pests that gather in hordes and raid settlements.
creatures.worth: Goblin ears can be turned in for guild bounties.

nature: Dungeons spontaneously form across the land, producing monsters and treasure chests filled with System-sanctioned loot.

rungs.name: E-Rank (Level 11-25)
rungs.description: Competent fighters capable of handling minor monsters.

rungs.name: C-Rank (Level 41-60)
rungs.description: Elite warriors respected in major towns.

rungs.name: B-Rank (Level 61-80)
rungs.description: Masters of their craft, capable of conquering dangerous dungeons.

rungs.name: A-Rank (Level 81-95)
rungs.description: Nationally renowned heroes and legendary commanders.

rungs.name: S-Rank (Level 96-100+)
rungs.description: The strongest beings in the world, matching demigods in power.

travel.description: People travel by foot, horse, or carriage. Major cities are linked by magical teleportation gates used only by the wealthy.

medicine.healing: Minor wounds are cured with potions; high-level holy magic can heal lost limbs.

laws.text: Monsters must be hunted under the authority of the Adventurers Guild.

norms: Leveling up is considered the ultimate pursuit of status and strength.

rules.text: The System assigns levels, attributes, and skills to all living beings in this world.
Magic requires the expenditure of Mana, which is calculated and regulated by the System.
Outworlders who die and cross over into this world are granted a single unique cheat skill of incredible power.

mysteries.question: How did I end up in this world with this cheat skill?
mysteries.answer: A goddess of rebirth pulled the player's soul from Earth just as the truck struck them, granting them the ultimate cheat skill so they could defeat a rising threat to the System itself.
clues: A strange, holy emblem carved into the status screen of your cheat skill.
Rumors of 'Outworlders' who historically saved the world from collapse.
A faint, divine voice whispering of a cosmic duty during level-ups.

player.name: Leo
player.description: An average young man from Earth trying to adjust to his new life as a fantasy hero.
player.appearance: Slightly messy dark hair, blue eyes, an average build, wearing basic starter leather armor and a plain tunic.

traits.name: Otherworlder
traits.description: Leo is from modern Earth, meaning he has no knowledge of local customs but possesses a unique worldview.

talents.name: Cheat Skill Integration
talents.covers: mastering any magic or technique he attempts instantly
talents.reason: Reincarnated by cosmic forces with an rule-breaking system ability.

powers.name: Infinite Adaptability
powers.description: An overpowered cheat skill that allows Leo to bypass System restrictions, instantly master any skill he witnesses, and gain experience at ten times the normal rate.
limits: Can only instantly learn skills that he physically witnesses being performed or reads in specialized grimoires.

items.name: Rookie Iron Sword
items.description: A basic, heavy iron sword issued to beginner adventurers.

gideon.name: Guildmaster Gideon
gideon.description: A scarred, muscular veteran adventurer who retired to run the Oakhaven branch.
gideon.appearance: Broad shoulders, a thick grey beard, a long scar across his left eye, wearing leather and chainmail.

fears: losing the town under his watch
wants: Maintain order and prepare Oakhaven for upcoming threats.

elara.name: Elara
elara.description: The cheerful and efficient receptionist at the Oakhaven Guild Hall.
elara.appearance: Slender build, long blonde hair tied back, wearing a neat green-and-white guild uniform.

wants: Help new adventurers find their footing safely.

adventurers-guild.name: Adventurers Guild
adventurers-guild.description: A continent-spanning organization that registers monster hunters and issues rewards.
adventurers-guild.strength: High-level guild champions and immense wealth accumulated from dungeon crawls.

oakhaven.name: Oakhaven
oakhaven.description: A peaceful border town surrounded by thick forests, popular with rookie adventurers.

guild-hall.name: Oakhaven Guild Hall
guild-hall.description: A lively wooden hall filled with adventurers drinking, boasting, and taking quests from the board.

whispering-woods.name: Whispering Woods
whispering-woods.description: A dense, shadowy forest home to wild beasts and goblin scouting parties.

goblin-caves.name: Goblin Caves
goblin-caves.description: A damp, dark network of underground tunnels where the local goblin tribe nests.

goblin-raid.name: The Goblin Horde attacks Oakhaven
steps: Scouts report goblin war parties gathering in the Whispering Woods.
Goblin vanguard scouts approach the town walls, cutting off Oakhaven's roads.
The horde launches a full assault on the Oakhaven gates.

event-1.title: The Goblin Horde attacks Oakhaven: Scouts report goblin war parties gathering in the Whispering Woods.

positions: Leo stands before the main counter.
scene.ended_on: Gideon and Elara wait behind the counter for you to step forward and speak.

state.summary: After a sudden truck accident on Earth, the player is reincarnated into a fantasy world governed by a video-game-like System. Starting as a Level 1 novice in the town of Oakhaven, they possess an overpowered cheat skill and must quickly grow stronger before a nearby goblin horde threatens the town.

scenes.narration:
You blink, and the cold metal of the truck on Earth is replaced by the warmth of polished wood and the smell of roasted meat. You are standing in the Oakhaven Guild Hall, where chatter, clinking tankards, and the scraping of benches create a lively din. Right before your eyes, a translucent, blue holographic window floats in the air, glowing with crisp, golden text: [System Notification: Cheat Skill 'Infinite Adaptability' Integrated. Bypassing standard limitations... Experience gain increased tenfold.] You stare at the screen, your heart hammering against your leather starter armor. It is real. You actually reincarnated.

"First time seeing a System screen, lad?" a booming, gravelly voice chuckles. 

Behind the heavy oak counter stands Guildmaster Gideon, a broad-shouldered veteran with a thick grey beard and a formidable scar running down his left eye. Beside him, Elara, the cheerful blonde receptionist in a neat green guild uniform, smiles warmly. She taps a blank wooden registration plaque on the counter. "Don't worry, the dizzy spell always passes. Once you're ready, we can get your F-Rank rookie plate registered. What is your name, adventurer?"

choices: Introduce yourself as Leo and ask about your first quest.
Examine the floating System screen to learn more about your cheat.
Ask Gideon and Elara about Oakhaven and the whispering woods.
